source.title: The Culling
source.description:
The city behind us is a haunted place. I spent years here after my original death as a thrall of the Lich King yet even in my servitude, I maintained some amount of awareness. Countless times, I shambled by the body of my wife, frozen forever in the fear she felt when the end came.

Please make your way through gate leading to the area now known as Slaughter Square. I will meet you there when I find my resolve. You will need allies for this.
source.objective: Enter Stratholme and make your way through the gate leading into Slaughter Square and find Leonid Barthalomew the Revered there.
source.completion: So now you see why I despise Caldoran. He is a man of hateful zealotry. He was then, and he is now. Caldoran did not accompany Arthas's expedition to Northrend, but I dearly wish he had found his end there and this was the end of our history together.
